cena: Mr. Haddad chegou ao pronto-socorro. A Dra. Caroline reconstrói o que aconteceu: quando começou, o que ele estava fazendo, o que tomou, se já melhorou alguma vez.
gramatica: Passado simples: verbos regulares e irregulares, a pergunta com did e a negativa didn't.

imagem.alt: Numa sala de emergência, a médica se inclina ao lado da maca onde o paciente está sentado com a mão no peito; ao fundo, um monitor com linhas simples.
imagem.prompt: Warm, friendly 2D vector illustration, flat modern style with soft shading. Inside a calm emergency room bay with a curtain partly drawn. A man in his fifties sits on a gurney, one hand resting on his chest, looking a little shaken but stable. A woman doctor in a white coat over teal scrubs leans in beside him, listening closely with a clipboard lowered at her side. Behind them, a vital signs monitor shows simple abstract waveform lines and no numbers. A blood pressure cuff rests on the bed rail. Limited palette of teal, cyan, warm sand and deep navy. Clean shapes, soft shadows. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers anywhere in the image.

linhas.pt: O que o senhor estava fazendo?

linhas.en: I was walking up the stairs.
Did you take anything for it?
linhas.pt: O senhor tomou alguma coisa para isso?

linhas.en: I took a painkiller. It didn't help.
Did you feel dizzy or sick?
linhas.pt: O senhor sentiu tontura ou enjoo?

linhas.en: I felt sick, yes. I sat down.
linhas.pt: Senti enjoo, sim. Eu me sentei.

linhas.en: No. This was the first time.
My son drove me. He waited outside.
linhas.pt: Meu filho me trouxe. Ele esperou lá fora.
O senhor fez a coisa certa.
